_comment: WORKER KEYS USB (x86_64 GPU host) = KEYS ONLY. No users.json or service config — those live only on the pki node. Carries join/mesh/CA keys + break-glass ssh/root.authorized_keys; joins the pki control-plane and is labelled for the games/GPU tier. ArgoCD schedules ArgoCD + snapdragon.games + backend capacity here; Vault/ESO deliver secrets.
_comment_mesh: Leave endpoint empty to default tailscale login_server to the pki node's LAN IP (works before public DNS). cp_dns_name is the stable control-plane name the kubeadm join targets over the mesh.
_comment_kubernetes: Worker join. api_server left empty auto-targets cp_dns_name:6443 over the mesh. To run THIS node as an ADDITIONAL HA control-plane instead, set role=control-plane, bootstrap=true, first=false, and add join.certificate_key (from `kubeadm init phase upload-certs --upload-certs` on the first CP).
